title: Chandipura Virus Disease (CHPV) Outbreak Triggers Acute Encephalitis Syndrome Alerts
summary: Rare vector-borne viral illness causing AES.

blocks.content: Rare vector-borne viral illness causing AES.

items: Union Health Ministry issued nationwide alert for Chandipura Virus Disease (CHPV) following acute encephalitis syndrome cases in Gujarat and Rajasthan.
Transmitted by sandflies; causes high fever and brain inflammation.
